tools.name: nl_vehicle
tools.description: Dutch number plate (kenteken) lookup from the Dutch vehicle authority RDW: make, model, body, colour, doors, seats, engine, power, fuel, CO2, weights, towing, original list price, first registration, MOT (APK) expiry, insured, open recall, odometer verdict. (cost: 20 credits)

tools.name: vin_decode
tools.description: Decode a VIN (vehicle identification number): make, model, year, trim, body, doors, engine, transmission, drive, fuel, seats, plant, airbags and driver-assist kit (NHTSA vPIC). Fullest for North American vehicles. (cost: 5 credits)

tools.name: uk_vehicle
tools.description: UK number plate lookup from official DVSA MOT records: make, model, colour, fuel, engine size, first registration date, MOT expiry, outstanding recall flag, latest mileage, and the full MOT test history with failures and advisories. Does not include road tax status. Cars under 3 years old have no MO

tools.name: uk_mot_history
tools.description: Full MOT test history for a UK number plate from DVSA: every test date, pass or fail, expiry, recorded mileage, and each failure, advisory and dangerous defect. For checking a used car before buying or when the next MOT is due. (cost: 10 credits)

tools.name: uk_mileage_check
tools.description: Checks whether a UK car's recorded mileage ever went backwards between MOT tests (a sign of clocking), with the latest reading and the number of readings, from official DVSA MOT records. (cost: 10 credits)

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "uk_vehicle" appears informational but accepts parameters (history) that enable code/file/secret access.
